question: Under what extreme condition of being bitten by great serpents is poison said not to enter the body?
premises: Poison is the thing in question.
A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Even in that condition, poison does not enter the body.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: The reason poison does not enter is not stated by this verse alone.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
